channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: Learning Without Local Minima: Gauge Freedom Makes Matrix Product States Trainable
item.description: Gauge freedom in matrix product states creates a smooth energy landscape, eliminating poor local minima and enabling reliable quantum training.

item.title: When Topology Learns to Dance: A Quantum Walk Through the Shape of Data
item.description: A quantum walker dances through a simplicial complex, using coherent interference to reveal hidden topological holes in high-dimensional data.

item.title: How Noise Taught Quantum Computers to Tame Turbulence
item.description: By injecting noise into turbulent dynamics, a new quantum algorithm transforms exponential complexity into logarithmic cost, turning randomness into a computational resource.

item.title: Quantum Fluctuations Strengthen Memory in Neural Networks
item.description: Quantum fluctuations selectively smooth narrow spin-glass valleys, preserving broad memory valleys and raising the retrieval temperature in vector Hopfield networks.

item.title: Squeezing Light from Semiconductor Vibrations
item.description: Phonon vibrations in a semiconductor microcavity squeeze light below the quantum noise limit, enabling chip-scale squeezed light sources.
